title: Contract self-destruct via selfdestruct (solidity) — review required
description: The solidity sink selfdestruct removes the contract code and forwards its balance. Without a guard, anyone who reaches the call can destroy the contract. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms it sits behind an owner-only path.
remediation: Remove selfdestruct or gate it behind an owner-only, reviewed migration path.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any selfdestruct call matches, including guarded calls.
